description: Searches Domus Aedes' own portfolio of properties to buy, rent long-term, or stay in (short-term) across Spain and Morocco. Returns up to six best matches for the criteria, whether more matches exist, and refinement suggestions (budget, area, bedrooms, features) that narrow the search. Budgets are EUR: total price for buy, per month for rent, per night for stay. Give check_in/check_out for live availability and a stay total. A stay search our own portfolio cannot serve returns no results and a concierge referral (concierge.domusaedes.com).

budget_max.description: EUR, inclusive. buy = total price · rent = per month · stay = per night

budget_min.description: EUR. buy = total price · rent = per month · stay = per night

features.description: Required features; every listed feature must be present

intent.description: buy = purchase · rent = long-term monthly let · stay = short-term holiday stay with live availability

language.description: Language of the person (labels, summaries and messages come back in it). Default en

location.description: City, area or country in the person's words, e.g. "Marbella", "Puerto Banús", "Marrakech", "Costa del Sol", "Catalonia", "Spain"

property_type.description: Kind of home, only if the person names one: villa, flat, penthouse, townhouse, country (country house or finca), plot, commercial, studio, riad

name: search_properties
title: Search Domus Aedes properties
